decision_needed.question: Interfund loans: Sales Tax Loan Advances (769,250) and Sales Tax Loans Repaid 300,718 sit in governmental other financing, and the budget schedule shows transfers in of 1,374,195 and total disbursements and transfers far above the fund statements. Should these interfund loan flows be treated as transfers or left as other financing?
decision_needed.recorded_as: net sales tax loan advances/repayments (-468,532) within other_financing with sale of assets and grant loans; transfers_in 24,000 and transfers_out 30,000 as printed

notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis; business-type funds (Electric, Water, Sewer, Gas, Golf Course) are full accrual, so business_type measure is net position. Governmental beginning/ending 'cash' are the beginning/ending fund balances (7,567,695 / 7,632,690, p13), which are cash-basis balances; roll-forward 7,567,695 + 3,245,670 - 2,784,735 + 24,000 - 30,000 - 389,940 = 7,632,690. Sale of assets (84,447) is shown by the report under other financing, so it is in other_financing, not receipts. Total column of each statement used (adjustments column nets to zero apart from interfund eliminations). Business-type roll-forward: 9,347,486 + 5,458,229 - 5,539,538 + 6,000 = 9,272,177; business-type disbursements total 5,539,538 is the printed total on the Statement of Activities (p3) and equals operating expenses 5,479,731 plus interest expense 59,807; principal payments (350,000) are not expenses on this accrual statement. Business-type receipts total computed (no single printed total). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (pp1-2, added by the re-trim; it includes capital assets, debt and loans, so it is used instead of the governmental funds balance sheet), governmental and business-type columns, each line tagged fund_type; it balances (assets 31,905,191 = liabilities 5,484,807 + net position 26,420,384). Detail: the Schedule of Expenditures - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (pp23-24, left half added by the re-trim; fund x object, total 2,784,735 = statement expenditures) gives the governmental expenditure lines by fund; Public Health Fund lines are tagged public safety (it also holds public health 108,461). P25 electrical statistics not recorded. 2026-10-27 fixes: budget-schedule Transfers In 1,374,195 split into governmental 1,288,735 and business-type 85,460 (Sewer 55,460 + Golf 30,000, p17); Electric 4,279,247 split into spending 4,199,787 and Transfers Out (79,460) (p17); 'Other' business-type 644,388 is the Golf Course Fund (Gas has no expenses). Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (pp8-13, pp16-17) replace the combined schedule (governmental revenue and other financing, and all business-type lines; the Adjustments column, which nets transfers in 1,264,735 against transfers out, is left out). Re-check 2026-10-28 (attempt 3): Debt Service Fund 'Debt Service' 319,543 (p23, not split on the schedule) recategorised as debt service (principal and interest combined). Read pages 1-25 of 25
